# Data

- DAT-003: Every migration of a database that more than one version of the app can reach (a server database, not one on the user's device) keeps working with the version still running: a schema change is split into expand (add, in one release), migrate (move data and code over) and contract (drop or rename, in a later release, once no running version uses the old shape); each call in a migration's Up that drops, renames or alters something, changes data or runs raw SQL carries a '// DAT-003: <reason>' comment, directly above it or at the end of the line it starts on, saying why the running version still works.
- DAT-013: Use expand -> migrate -> contract schema changes to keep old and new app versions compatible during a transition.
